requiredFindings.title: The libc size assertion accepts a numeric prefix rather than the whole value
requiredFindings.finding: recorded collects initial ASCII digits and immediately parses them, without checking the following token boundary. A record containing "libc::stat": 144.5 or 144e9 yields Some(144), allowing this standalone platform assertion to pass despite the recorded number differing from size_of::<libc::stat>(). The same issue applies to attrlist and statfs. The security CAN parser rejects floats elsewhere, so this is not a claim that such modified records pass the complete suite; the requested platform exact whole-number assertion itself is incomplete.
requiredFindings.requiredCorrection: Validate that the complete value is an unsigned integer followed only by permitted whitespace and the expected JSON delimiter, or parse the sizes object with an appropriate strict integer parser. Keep duplicate-key rejection. Add focused controls showing exact integers pass and fractional/exponent/prefix-only values refuse.
